_meta.description: High-value award redemptions (fixed/known rates plus the partner booking path). Each entry pairs a route or region pattern with the cheapest program to book it. Rates devalue; verify before booking.

sweet_spots.booking_path: Search ANA space on united.com, book by phone with Virgin Atlantic Flying Club. Get a hold before transferring points.
sweet_spots.notes: Legendary redemption. Round-trip only on ANA via Virgin. Business ~52.5K, First ~72.5K from West Coast.

sweet_spots.booking_path: Book on iberia.com. Off-peak pricing. Transfer Avios from Amex/Chase/Bilt/Capital One.
sweet_spots.notes: Off-peak 40,500 Avios business class is one of the best transatlantic values.

sweet_spots.route_pattern: US to Middle East / Asia via Doha
sweet_spots.booking_path: Book Qsuites saver via Qatar Privilege Club (Avios). Low surcharges on Qatar metal.
sweet_spots.notes: Qsuites is a top business product. Hard to find 2+ seats; search early.

sweet_spots.booking_path: Search United space, book via Turkish Miles&Smiles. 10K short-haul, 15K longer.
sweet_spots.notes: Cheap domestic United flights. Turkish booking can require phone and patience.

sweet_spots.booking_path: Watch monthly Flying Blue Promo Rewards for discounted business-class awards. Transfer from Amex/Chase/Bilt/Capital One/Citi.
sweet_spots.notes: Promo awards vary monthly and can undercut the standard chart significantly.

sweet_spots.booking_path: Lufthansa First space usually opens ~15 days out. Book via Aeroplan. Transfer from Amex/Chase/Bilt/Capital One.
sweet_spots.notes: One of the few programs that can book Lufthansa First for partners.

sweet_spots.booking_path: Book on TAP Miles&Go fixed chart. No direct US credit-card transfer partners, so earn via flying or Miles&Go promos.
sweet_spots.notes: Fixed-chart option to Portugal with a free Lisbon stopover on some fare rules.
